stem: A community garden charges its members a one-time joining fee plus a fixed fee for each month of membership. After 5 months, a member has paid a total of 215 dollars. After 12 months, the member has paid a total of 432 dollars. What is the joining fee, in dollars?
solution: In 7 more months the total grew by \(432 - 215 = 217\) dollars, so the monthly fee is \(\frac{217}{7} = 31\) dollars.
verify:
m = Rational(432 - 215, 12 - 5)
fee = 215 - 5*m
assert m == 31 and fee == 60 and fee + 12*m == 432
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [fee]
